answer: A sybil-resistant registry binds each agent identity to a costly non-transferable credential. Registration means staking capital and passing a live capability test, so each extra identity must clear it alone: a canyon of duplicated proof-of-work widening per clone. Reputation accrues only to credentials that settled real transactions, and payout caps leave a fresh sybil a dry oasis with no history to borrow. Slashing burns a proven forger's stake, and a global rate limit makes each marginal clone worthless before its bond returns, so honest agents cross the glacier of reputation once.
